lessons_used: Reordering sign-in earlier (after adoption selection or photo upload) was helpful (+3.3% to +5.5%), but placing it after the adoption certificate caused a severe drop (-22.4%).

Specific layout redesigns (Stage, Scroll, Grid, Checklist), select new screens (Visibility Check, Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration), desktop background prompts, and clear hints (Path Selection, Sign-In Clarification, Multi-Account Preservation, Story Interaction) were helpful.
Copy updates, incentives, audio/sound cues, notification banners/toggles, and waiting screen info components showed no clear effect.

Several layout redesigns degraded performance severely (e.g., Photo Upload Grid -23.3%, Pick Friend Split -17.2%), while multiple new screens (Controls Overview, Bio Preview, Placement Guide, Troubleshooter) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently too high for non-winning changes, projecting gains up to +12.0% on tests that showed no clear effect or degraded conversion.
Predictions were often too low for winning changes, predicting negative or modest impact (-5.0% to +3.7%) on features that ultimately delivered large wins (+3.3% to +14.0%).
